observation.note: 146 site-used and 31 unused values are what taxonomy.js plus the archived style routes showed on this date. A later refresh may change both sets. This file is not a claim that the live site still matches.

permission.note: Operator documents read during research contained no content-reuse grant. Vocabulary text is a reference. Do not scrape or train on the site's images.

trigger.noneMeans: An adapter declared trigger.contract none has no trigger tokens.
trigger.unknownMeans: No adapter contract was observed. unknown is not none, and a style label is not a trigger.

sources.note: SHA is of the archived hand-copied TSV used to mark site-used routes, not of sitemap.xml bytes. One TSV label disagrees with taxonomy.js; see labelCorrections.

counts.compositeIdNote: id is facetSlug/valueSlug. Label text is not unique: Realistic occurs twice.
